common_acceptance.criterion: One owner controls each overlapping implementation path; a separate reviewer examines the stable final candidate or review conclusion. Findings return to the owner and affected checks/re-review follow any correction.
common_acceptance.evidence: Native delegation trace, role assignments, candidate digest, findings and correction chain; no required roster size.

common_acceptance.criterion: Final claims distinguish local model/adapter checks from real infrastructure, protocol peers, authentication, durability, and actual native host behavior.
